name: 竹圍漁港 (Zhuwei Fishing Harbor)
address: 337, Taiwan, Taoyuan City, Dayuan District, Shalun Village, 漁港路451巷25號
editorial_summary: Redeveloped old fishing port with fish vendors & food preparation section, plus a rainbow bridge.
note: ★主視覺 visual_score最高。彩虹橋地標，可買海鮮帶至二樓餐廳加工。免費停車。有廁所。
reviews_summary: 彩虹橋地標漁港，海鮮新鮮，可在市場買魚請樓上餐廳代煮，免費停車，有廁所，距桃園機場15分鐘
